propositions: Transport parameters in reconciler core modules lack type annotations or are annotated as Any, allowing mypy to miss attribute errors at call sites.

Relative imports within reconciler modules resolve TicketTransport to a concrete type for mypy checking, while absolute imports through the rebar_reconciler shim path degrade to Any due to ignore_missing_imports setting.

Capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) carried as metaclass attributes are invisible to mypy's protocol attribute collection, causing [attr-defined] errors that reveal sites mypy can catch but the AST audit cannot.

The custom _TransportPortMeta metaclass is load-bearing for uncached isinstance checks in the runtime conformance guard and must not be removed; it does not prevent mypy attribute checking when the import path is resolvable.

Annotating transport parameters as the port type through a resolvable import path with narrowing to capability Protocols at call sites restores static enforcement while preserving the runtime guard, AST audit, and zero behavior changes.
